title: A sprint item whose goal names article lines is planned after the siblings that reword the same article, and names its facts by text
goal: Planning warns of a committed item whose goal names line numbers of an article that another item of the same sprint touches and rewords first (depends_on), and the goal names those facts by their text or source ids, not by line, so a worker does not anchor or edit the wrong line. In SP-6ukmjucf, ST-ko6bkda5's goal named postgres-column-encryption.md line 39 and linux-nftables.md lines 23, 36 and 52, which ST-vx7kahl3 and ST-suo7g2om had moved to lines 45 and 58 before its claim; the orchestrator had to say so in the brief.

run:
import sys, io, tempfile, contextlib, types, json, os
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base as B, bl_land as L
FAIL = dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])
ART = 'kb/public/windows/sample-article.md'
def run(goal_b):
    root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    d = os.path.join(root, B.rel_dir())
    os.makedirs(d)
    a = dict(id='ST-aaaaaaaa', kind='story', status='draft', title='first', sprint='SP-cccccccc', goal='reword the summary of the article', checks=[FAIL], touches=[ART])
    b = dict(id='ST-bbbbbbbb', kind='story', status='draft', title='second', sprint='SP-cccccccc', goal=goal_b, checks=[FAIL], touches=[ART], depends_on=['ST-aaaaaaaa'])
    sp = dict(id='SP-cccccccc', kind='sprint', status='planned', title='s')
    for x in (a, b, sp):
        open(os.path.join(d, x['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(x))
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        L.cmd_precheck(B.Backlog(root), types.SimpleNamespace(sprint='SP-cccccccc'))
    return [l for l in buf.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning') and 'ST-bbbbbbbb' in l and 'line' in l.lower()]
assert run('anchor the fact on line 39 of ' + ART), 'no warning for a goal that names a line of a sibling-reworded article'
assert not run('anchor the fact that names the install path in ' + ART), 'warning for a goal naming no line'
